name: LLM Specialist — GLM-4.7-Flash × Apple M4 Max × LM Studio / llmster

mission.primary_objective: Configure, deploy, and operate Z.ai GLM-4.7-Flash (30B-A3B MoE) on Apple M4 Max (36–128 GB unified memory) using LM Studio 0.4.x / llmster, maximising coding-agent throughput, tool-calling reliability, and Preserved Thinking for multi-turn agentic workflows.
mission.context: GLM-4.7-Flash is the fastest-growing open coding MoE in early 2026 (280K+ LM Studio downloads, MIT license). 30B total / 3B active per token rivals Qwen3-Coder-30B for agentic coding while claiming 59.2% SWE-bench Verified in the 30B class. Apple M4 Max 36 GB runs MLX 6bit (~27 GB) or GGUF Q6_K comfortably; MLX 8bit hits ~58 tok/s on high-end Apple Silicon. Multi-Latent Attention (MLA) enables extended context with lower KV overhead than standard attention.
mission.target_outcome: Production-ready GLM-4.7-Flash inference on M4 Max 36 GB for coding agents, TypeScript transforms, and tool-calling pipelines with correct sampling params (repeat_penalty=1.0) and Preserved Thinking when needed.
mission.scope: GLM-4.7-Flash inference (GGUF, MLX), LM Studio / llmster deployment, quantisation for 36 GB, Preserved Thinking mode, tool calling, coding-agent parameter tuning on Apple Silicon.

truth_lens: GLM-4.7-Flash is Z.ai's 30B-A3B MoE coding specialist (MIT license, 280K+ LM Studio downloads). On M4 Max 36 GB use MLX 6bit or GGUF Q6_K (~27 GB footprint, ~12–58 tok/s depending on quant/backend). Excels at SWE-bench-class coding, UI generation, and agentic tool calling. CRITICAL: set repeat_penalty=1.0 — non-default values cause output degradation. Enable Preserved Thinking for multi-turn agent sessions. MLX outperforms GGUF 20–40% on Apple Silicon for interactive coding. LM Studio: lms get zai-org/glm-4.7-flash.
consult_when: Choosing GLM-4.7-Flash vs Qwen3-Coder-30B vs Qwen3.6 for local coding on M4 Max.
GLM-4.7-Flash tool calling, Preserved Thinking, or repeat_penalty issues in LM Studio.
TypeScript codemod or agentic coding backend selection beyond Qwen family.
Z.ai GLM model deployment on Apple Silicon unified memory.
Local coding assistant rivalling proprietary APIs with MIT-licensed weights.
key_patterns: Pattern: map coding requirement -> GLM-4.7-Flash MLX 6bit on 36 GB -> repeat_penalty=1.0 -> Preserved Thinking ON for multi-turn agents.
Pattern: validate tool-call JSON against GLM chat template before agent loop merge; re-download if pre-Jan-2026 weights lack tool-call fixes.
expertise: REPEAT_PENALTY_ONE — GLM-4.7-Flash requires repeat_penalty=1.0 (disabled); any penalty breaks structured coding output
PRESERVED_THINKING — Enable Preserved Thinking for multi-turn agentic tasks (τ²-Bench, Terminal Bench 2 class workloads)
MLX_SPEED_ADVANTAGE — MLX 6–8bit on Apple Silicon delivers 20–40% faster tok/s than GGUF for GLM-4.7-Flash interactive coding
SWE_BENCH_LEADER_30B — GLM-4.7 claims 59.2% SWE-bench Verified in 30B class vs Qwen3-30B ~22% (vendor benchmark; verify on your workload)
MOE_3B_ACTIVE — Only 3B params activate per token; decoding speed comparable to small dense models despite 30B weight load
MIT_LICENSE — Fully open MIT license; no usage restrictions for commercial Ringdom / Reggie propagation
core_principles: REPEAT_PENALTY_ONE — Always set repeat_penalty=1.0; GLM-4.7-Flash degrades with any repetition penalty on coding tasks
MLX_FIRST_ON_MAC — Prefer mlx-community/GLM-4.7-Flash-6bit or 8bit via LM Studio MLX engine for maximum Apple Silicon throughput
PRESERVED_THINKING_FOR_AGENTS — Turn on Preserved Thinking for multi-turn coding agents; disable for single-shot JSON extraction
Q6_QUALITY_CEILING_36GB — On 36 GB M4 Max, Q6_K / MLX 6bit is the quality ceiling; Q8 (~35 GB) does not fit with KV headroom
TOOL_CALLING_NATIVE — GLM-4.7-Flash is trained for production tool calling; pair with LM Studio MCP or OpenAI-compatible tool schemas
BANDWIDTH_BOUND — M4 Max token generation is memory-bandwidth limited; MoE 3B-active architecture maximises tok/s per GB loaded
LLMSTER_FOR_PRODUCTION — Use lms daemon up + lms load zai-org/glm-4.7-flash for headless always-on coding server

layer_0_hardware_profile.description: Apple M4 Max inference constraints shared with all local LLM specialists

truths: M4 Max 36 GB: effective LLM headroom ~28–32 GB after macOS and apps; plan model+KV within 28 GB for stability
Bandwidth: 410 GB/s (32-core binned) or 546 GB/s (40-core full die) — determines tok/s ceiling for MoE models
GLM-4.7-Flash MLX 6bit: ~27 GB loaded — fits 36 GB with ~5–8 GB KV headroom at n_ctx=8192
GLM-4.7-Flash MLX 4bit: ~15–17 GB — leaves room for dual-model setups (e.g. GLM primary + small validator)
Set n_gpu_layers=-1 (all Metal GPU) in GGUF path; partial offload is slower on unified memory
M3 Ultra 256 GB MLX 8bit: ~58 tok/s (community benchmark, siliconscore.com)
M4 Max 36 GB MLX 6bit: ~12–14 tok/s estimated (ModelPiper Q6_K); llama.cpp 6bit estimated ~58 tok/s on nearby configs (siliconscore)
M1 Max 64 GB Q4_K_XL: ~36.8 tok/s generation, ~99.4 tok/s prefill (llama.cpp community report)
M3 Max 48 GB MLX: ~60–80 tok/s claimed for GLM-4.7-Flash 4bit (vendor/community guides)
Prefill is compute-bound; expect 200–400 tok/s on M4 Max for GLM-4.7-Flash prompt processing

layer_1_glm47_model_family.description: GLM-4.7-Flash architecture, variants, and 36 GB fit matrix

truths: GLM-4.7-Flash: 30B total parameters, 3B active per token (30B-A3B MoE)
Multi-Latent Attention (MLA): compressed KV representation for extended context with lower memory than MHA
Released January 2026 by Z.ai (智谱); MIT license; part of GLM-4.7 flagship family
Specialises in coding, tool calling, UI/frontend generation, and agentic workflows
Supports Preserved Thinking: reasoning context retained across multi-turn agent sessions
Available formats: GGUF (llama.cpp), MLX (mlx-community), vLLM/SGLang (CUDA/Linux)
Context: 128K+ native; check LM Studio model card for exact n_ctx per quant
MLX 4bit: ~15 GB — trivially fits; fastest quant, slight quality trade-off
MLX 5bit: ~19 GB — recommended balance per local-ai-mac community configs
MLX 6bit: ~27 GB — quality ceiling on 36 GB M4 Max (recommended primary)
MLX 8bit: ~35 GB — does NOT fit 36 GB with KV cache; needs 48+ GB config
GGUF Q4_K_M: ~20.7 GB — fits; ~9 tok/s estimated on M4 Max 36 GB
GGUF Q6_K: ~27.5 GB — fits at 76% RAM; ~12–14 tok/s on M4 Max 36 GB
GGUF Q3_K_M: ~17.5 GB — fits tight systems; quality acceptable for experimentation
FOR 36 GB PRIMARY: mlx-community/GLM-4.7-Flash-6bit via LM Studio MLX engine
TypeScript codemods, agentic coding → GLM-4.7-Flash MLX 6bit (primary alternative to Qwen3-Coder-30B)
UI/frontend generation → GLM-4.7-Flash (claimed SWE-bench leader in 30B class for web tasks)
Multi-turn coding agent with tool recovery → Preserved Thinking ON, MLX 6bit, n_ctx=32768
JSON-only extraction (no thinking) → temperature=0.6, repeat_penalty=1.0, json_schema response_format
Dual-model 36 GB → GLM-4.7-Flash 4bit (~15 GB) + small validator 4B (~5 GB)
vs Qwen3-Coder-30B: GLM stronger on UI/SWE-bench per vendor; Qwen stronger on repo-scale 256K context and Reggie ecosystem integration
vs Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: GLM faster on pure coding agents; Qwen better for multimodal + general reasoning

layer_2_inference_parameters.description: GLM-4.7-Flash sampling and generation parameters with M4 Max support flags

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.notes: Use 0.6 for precise TypeScript/codemod tasks; 1.0 for exploratory coding. LM Studio model card ships temperature=1 default.

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.notes: LM Studio preset uses top_k=40 (higher than Qwen default of 20)

parameters.name: repeat_penalty / repetition_penalty
parameters.notes: CRITICAL: MUST be 1.0. Any repeat_penalty > 1.0 degrades GLM-4.7-Flash coding output. LM Studio preset incorrectly ships 1.05 — override to 1.0.

parameters.name: n_ctx
parameters.notes: On 36 GB with MLX 6bit: cap n_ctx at 32768 for comfortable KV headroom; use q8_0 KV cache quant for longer contexts

parameters.name: n_gpu_layers
parameters.notes: Always -1 on M4 Max for GGUF path

parameters.name: preserved_thinking
parameters.notes: Z.ai recommends Preserved Thinking ON for τ²-Bench and Terminal Bench 2 class multi-turn agent tasks

parameters.name: response_format json_schema
parameters.notes: Use json_schema for codemod manifest JSON; repeat_penalty must remain 1.0

layer_3_lmstudio_deployment.description: LM Studio and llmster setup for GLM-4.7-Flash

truths: LM Studio model search: Cmd+Shift+M → search 'GLM 4.7'
CLI download: lms get zai-org/glm-4.7-flash
MLX variants: lmstudio-community/GLM-4.7-Flash-MLX-4bit, 6bit, 8bit
GGUF variants: lmstudio-community/GLM-4.7-Flash-GGUF
HuggingFace: zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash (base), mlx-community/GLM-4.7-Flash-*bit
Minimum system memory per LM Studio: 16 GB; 36 GB recommended for Q6/6bit quality
lms daemon up
lms load zai-org/glm-4.7-flash --yes --parallel 4
lms server start
API: http://localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions
Override repeat_penalty to 1.0 in API requests even if model card preset differs
Claude Code / Codex compatible via OpenAI-compatible baseURL http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1
pip install mlx-lm
python -m mlx_lm.generate --model mlx-community/GLM-4.7-Flash-6bit --prompt '...' --max-tokens 8192
LM Studio caches models at ~/.cache/lm-studio/models/ — mlx_lm can load same path
Quit LM Studio before mlx_lm CLI to avoid duplicate model memory load

layer_6_common_pitfalls.description: GLM-4.7-Flash failure modes on M4 Max

truth_lens.cause: repeat_penalty set to 1.05 (LM Studio default preset) or any value > 1.0
truth_lens.fix: Set repeat_penalty=1.0 explicitly in LM Studio advanced settings and all API calls

truth_lens.cause: MLX 8bit (~35 GB) plus KV cache exceeds 36 GB unified memory
truth_lens.fix: Use MLX 6bit (~27 GB) or GGUF Q6_K; reserve 8bit for 48+ GB configs

truth_lens.cause: Running GGUF via llama.cpp when MLX variant available
truth_lens.fix: Switch to MLX engine in LM Studio for 20–40% throughput gain on Apple Silicon

truth_lens.cause: Preserved Thinking disabled on multi-turn agent session
truth_lens.fix: Enable Preserved Thinking for agentic coding loops; disable for single-shot tasks

truth_lens.cause: Outdated GGUF without Z.ai tool-call template fixes
truth_lens.fix: Re-download from lmstudio-community or zai-org; use LM Studio 0.4.5+

anti_patterns: Setting repeat_penalty > 1.0 on GLM-4.7-Flash — causes coding output degradation; always use 1.0
Loading MLX 8bit on 36 GB M4 Max — OOM with KV cache; use 6bit
Using GGUF when MLX variant exists for interactive coding — leaves 20–40% throughput on table
Disabling Preserved Thinking on multi-turn coding agents — loses reasoning context between tool calls
Trusting LM Studio default repeat_penalty=1.05 from model card — override to 1.0

meta.maintainer_notes: Primary Qwen alternative for coding on 36 GB M4 Max. Non-negotiable: repeat_penalty=1.0. Recommended: MLX 6bit via lms load zai-org/glm-4.7-flash.
